segments.text: CHriſt was circumciſed, 1. That hee might ſignifie that hee was alſo a member of that circumciſed people. 2. That hee might ſhew, that he receiued and tooke our ſinnes on himſelfe, that he might ſatisfie for them. 3. That he might teſtifie that he did entirelie and fullie fulfill the law in our behalfe. 4. The circumciſion of Chriſt was a part alſo of his humiliation and Ranſome.
